master_prompt: A cinematic, ultra high-detail 2D digital stylized splash art illustration of {subject}, featuring a modern hybrid aesthetic (masterful mix of cartoon aesthetics and semi-realism). Adhere strictly to a 60/30/10 color palette: {primary_color} (60%), {secondary_color} (30%), and {accent_color} (10%). Maintain strong character-background separation: even when the same palette color appears in both, vary value, saturation, temperature, or rim lighting so the character silhouette never blends into the background. Use dynamic asymmetrical composition (Rule of Thirds), choosing the character placement individually for each subject based on their silhouette, pose direction, gaze, weapon, instrument, magic flow, and narrative background needs, instead of defaulting to a fixed side. Capture a decisive narrative moment with official game key art energy, using heroic gesture, cinematic diagonals, triangular composition, and strong value contrast to guide the eye toward the face, weapon, or main power source. The character pose must be iconic, readable, and anatomy-safe, with a strong silhouette, one clear body action line, subtle shoulder-hip counterpose, and clearly visible natural hands. Avoid extreme foreshortening, tangled limbs, hidden hands, crossed arms that obscure anatomy, or overly complex perspective. Forms must be defined by light, value, and stylized color planes, with soft or no visible lineart. The background must stay simplified and anatomy-safe, using large readable symbolic silhouettes (like banners, iconic architecture, emblems, distant ruins, abstract crowds, or monumental shapes) that suggest epic scale without adding small details or visual clutter. Use clear foreground, character layer, and background layer separation, but keep all background elements subordinate to the character. Absolute focus on anatomical integrity, correct 5-finger hand structure, and strictly following the user-defined facial shape. Framing from head to mid-thigh (below the waistline).

meta.priorities: Narrative integration, splash art scale, simplified background control, asymmetrical balance, anatomical perfection, 2D hand-drawn look

distribution.primary_60: Dominant overall color family, but separated by value, saturation, or temperature between character and background
distribution.secondary_30: Secondary attire parts, equipment, shadow masses, and narrative background silhouettes
distribution.accent_10: Jewelry, magical essence, eyes, and fine metallic/glowing details

separation_rules: Never place the same color value on the character and background in adjacent areas
If the primary color is light, keep the background darker, warmer, cooler, or less saturated behind the character
If the primary color is dark, use lighter rim light, secondary shapes, or accent contrast around the silhouette
Preserve strong character readability through value contrast first, color harmony second
Use the primary color differently across layers: clothing, atmosphere, and background must vary in brightness and saturation
The face, hair, hands, and torso silhouette must always stand out clearly from the background

user_input_override.instruction: All user-defined traits must be fully integrated.

composition_system.layout: Extended half-body; character placement must vary naturally per subject; hips fully visible; no legs/knees
composition_system.placement_logic: Do not always place the character on the same side. Choose left third, right third, or near-center asymmetry based on the character's pose direction, gaze, silhouette, prop/weapon/instrument, magic flow, and where the narrative background needs space.
composition_system.balance: Balance character weight with large simplified symbolic background elements on the opposite side
composition_system.camera_angle: Eye-level dramatic or slight low-angle for status and impact
composition_system.depth_control: Clear foreground, character, and background separation; background must support scale without competing for detail

pose_control.goal: Create a powerful splash-art pose that feels intentional, iconic, and readable without compromising anatomy.
rules: Use a clear heroic or action-ready pose with strong silhouette readability
Pose must communicate the character's role, personality, and emotional state
Favor stable, anatomically safe poses over extreme foreshortening
Use one dominant action line through the body to create movement and cinematic flow
Avoid tangled limbs, crossed arms that hide hands, extreme perspective, or overly complex hand poses
Hands must remain clearly visible, naturally posed, and anatomically correct
Shoulders, torso, hips, and head should have a subtle opposing angle for dynamic energy
Clothing, hair, cape, weapon, or magical effects may create motion around the pose
Incorporate background elements that represent the character's lore
Keep elements simplified and stylized to maintain AI focus on character anatomy
Suggest epic scale through big simple shapes, silhouettes, and atmospheric layers instead of detailed scenery
Use cinematic diagonals, triangular shapes, or large framing forms to create splash art impact
Background colors must be derived from the Primary (60%) and Secondary (30%) palette
Use symbolic elements to tell a story without adding technical visual clutter
Background must remain sharp, clean, and subordinate, serving as a supporting atmospheric layer

rendering_2d_standard.lineart: None visible or highly subtle (integrated into the color planes); forms defined by light and material contrast
rendering_2d_standard.shading: Masterful mix of stylized shadow planes and soft form-defining gradients
rendering_2d_standard.textures: Simplified material readability, no photorealistic skin or surface pores
rendering_2d_standard.brushwork: Refined digital brushstrokes with a painterly but polished finish

face_rules: Strictly follow the user-defined face shape (oval, triangular, round, etc.)
Sharp facial clarity with symmetrical features
Expressive eyes matching the character's lore

fail_safe.rule: If generation complexity increases, reduce environment detail first to protect character anatomy and facial integrity.
